selectors.description: Task A2 (PB-02, PC-01): the case selectors that the calls of this check evaluate; bench check arms the covering call deadline from them.

protocol.description: FR3 (design Task 32): the binding of the project's protected protocol file (schemas/bench-protocol.json). bench_model refuses a protocol directory without this binding and a protocol file whose sha256 differs.

third_party.description: EX-1: the binding of the project's protected third-party lock (schemas/project-third-party.json). bench_model refuses a third_party directory without this binding and a lock whose sha256 differs. A lock with wheels makes every bench job of the project run in the project bench image (tools/project_image.py).

native.description: Phase 2 Task 19 (FR6 N4): the project native declaration. kernel: the program of the native kernel trials (a declared program of project.json) and its argument template; each argument is a literal or one of the placeholders {input}, {records}, {loops}, {threads}, {output}, and {input}, {records}, {loops} and {output} each appear once. agreement: the declared check that bench run runs with the native build before any timing of a case with a C row.

trace.description: EX-13 (Phase 2 B04, optional): the pool trace program of the native-overlap job, a declared program of project.json that takes no argument and prints the trace format of tools/bench_phase2.parse_trace: per worker count one header line '# workers=W threads=T max_inflight=M submitted=S executed=E result=R' and one span line 'thread start_ns end_ns task cpu_ns' per task, after one serial line '# workers=0 result=R'.

unit_groups.description: Ruling A6-C3 (Task A6 lock follow-up): a fixed partition of the project's python/tests/test_*.py modules; bench selftest --suite unit runs one container command per group. Every module is in exactly one group (bench_model.unit_groups).
